motion_and_interactions.transcript_auto_scroll: Smooth scroll lock to bottom when new interpreted sentences arrive

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure all interactive elements and diagnostic displays have explicit data-testid attributes.
Dark theme is default with high-contrast AV console feel; do not use pure black gradients, use deep slate/navy #0A0D14 and #121824.
Tablet touch targets must be at least 48px in height and width with clear visual feedback.
Dropdowns, select boxes, and overlays must have solid/opaque dark backgrounds (never transparent).
PWA install manifest and service worker configuration must be accessible in public/ folder.
Route /debug must provide comprehensive diagnostic controls and WebRTC/session logs.
